## Change Summary

- **What changed?** Documentation only, in
  `cookbook/loongforge-vlda/README.md`:
  - Filled in the arXiv badge with the published paper link
    (`arXiv:2610.25874`, https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25874).
  - Added an **Evaluation results** subsection under §5 — the LIBERO 10-run
    summary table (4 suites × 10 runs, a per-run average column, and a final
    mean ± fluctuation row, highest per-column value in bold).
  - Added a **Citation** section with the paper's BibTeX entry.
- **Which issue or requirement does this address?** Links the public paper
  and records the released checkpoint's LIBERO benchmark results for the
  open-source recipe.
- **Which modules are affected?** `cookbook/loongforge-vlda/README.md` only.
  No source code, configs, scripts, or paths changed.

## Validation

- [x] I ran the relevant local checks. (`git diff` confirms only the three
      intended additions; 46 insertions / 1 deletion, no path or layout edits.)
- [ ] I added or updated tests where appropriate. (N/A — documentation only.)
- [x] I checked compatibility with existing APIs and configurations.
      (No code/config/path changes.)

## CI, GPU, and Image Impact

- [ ] This change affects dependencies, Dockerfiles, patches, or runtime environments.
- [ ] GPU validation is required. Suggested suite: `llm_vlm` / `embodied`.
- [ ] A local candidate image should be built during GPU validation.
- [x] No GPU or image validation is required.

## Reviewer Notes

- Please confirm the arXiv ID (`2610.25874`) is final before merge.
- Evaluation results are from 10 runs of the released Stage 2 checkpoint;
  "fluctuation" is `(max − min) / 2`. Swap to mean ± std if that matches the
  convention used elsewhere in the repo.
